notes: Official Nuvio Mobile Android build of the same monorepo/commit as the iOS 0.2.25 target (NuvioMedia__NuvioMobile__60cde30.json); '_android' suffix disambiguates the two platforms at one commit. Debug-signed, sideloadable APK (:androidApp:assembleFullDebug, appId com.nuviodebug.com) from the 'full' sideload flavor - NOT a Play-signed/release build; the auto Android debug keystore is used, no secrets. Runs on ubuntu-latest (no macOS 10x multiplier). VERSION-LAG (as with iOS): iosApp/Configuration/Version.xcconfig / the Android versionName lag the git tag, so the built app self-reports 0.2.24 (versionCode 96), not 0.2.25. FIRE TV CAVEAT: Nuvio has no leanback/Android-TV variant (phone LAUNCHER only, touch UI); it installs and runs on a Fire TV Stick 4K Max 2nd gen (Fire OS 8 / Android 11, arm64) but is navigated as a touch app - drive with a paired Bluetooth mouse/air-remote. Native libs ship arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a; minSdk 24.
